title: The Dying King's Final Request: One Last Game With the Blind Girl He Loves

cuts.raw_narration: In a small, quiet room, Komugi lies unconscious on a futon, her white hair spread around her, her scarred eyes closed. Meruem, the tall purple-skinned Chimera Ant King with a long tail and pointed crown-like head, kneels beside her in the low light, leans in, and speaks softly, almost tenderly: 'Wake up, Komugi. Let's play.'

Later, across a wooden Gungi board on the floor, Komugi stammers, still calling him 'Lord Meruem.' His purple eyes widen, almost pained. He cuts her off — that's a lie, he says. He knew nothing. He did not understand what truly mattered. 'Just Meruem,' he tells her. 'Do not make me repeat myself, Komugi.'

Deeper into the match, something breaks in Komugi. Tears well up in her huge, closed eyes and spill down her cheeks. Meruem freezes and asks quietly, 'Why do you cry?' Through the sobs she whispers that she has never been so happy — that wonderful things keep happening to somebody like her, and she doesn't know if it is allowed.

Sensing she deserves the truth, Meruem finally tells her. He has been poisoned, he says. He wants to spend his remaining moments playing with her — but if she stays by his side too long, this poison will take her too. She will also die.
Komugi does not flinch. Still shaking with tears, she whispers that she is so happy right now — she may not be worthy, but please, please let her go with him.

The poison finally catches them. Komugi tells him she must sleep, just for a little while, and asks — if she may make one small request — that he hold her hand until she wakes. In almost-total darkness, a single tiny purple mote of light hovers as her pale hand reaches out, trembling, and finds his cheek, then slides down until their fingers weave together. 'I've never left your side,' he tells her. 'We'll always be together.'

Softer than anything before, he asks: 'Say my name.' Her voice barely lifts above a breath. 'Good night… Meruem. It'll be all right. I'll be joining you soon.' The screen washes to pure white, and in a soft watercolor stillness Komugi is left cradling him in her lap, their hands still joined, a faint peaceful smile on her lips as they fade into the light together.
